upstream.revisionPolicy: Published Transformers support requires a main-branch install at publication time; evaluation must pin the exact transformers revision and NeoMME checkpoint revisions before any result is comparable.

materialChanges: Single-tower multimodal-native encoder family (260M and 800M): one bidirectional Transformer processes text tokens and raw 32x32 image patches with no separate vision tower and no causal decoder, trained from scratch with a masked discrete-diffusion objective over about 524B packed tokens.
16,384-token bidirectional context with sliding-window attention plus global attention every sixth layer, and a 131k multilingual BPE vocabulary.
NeoMME-Retriever dual-head variant returns dense and 128-d late-interaction embeddings for visual document retrieval in one forward pass, aligned with the SZL retrieval-benchmark plane.

Upstream reports ViDoRe v3 nDCG@10 of 0.523 at 260M parameters (highest below 800M; within 0.002 of ColQwen2.5 at about 14x fewer parameters) and 0.556 at 800M; about 51 pages per second at 2048x2048 on one L40S; and late-interaction storage reduced from about 1.5 MB to 6 kB per page (255x) while retaining more than 95 percent of baseline nDCG@10. All numbers are UPSTREAM_REPORTED_NOT_SZL_MEASURED.
Checkpoints released under Apache-2.0 with day-zero Transformers support that references transformers main at publication time, so exact-revision pinning is required before evaluation.

acceptance: Pin exact checkpoint revisions for the 260M and 800M encoder and Retriever variants and the exact transformers revision providing the NeoMME classes; never evaluate against moving main.

Reproduce retrieval quality on fixed non-secret SZL retrieval fixtures through the existing retrieval-bench lanes for both dense and late-interaction heads, or record honest UNAVAILABLE; never transcribe ViDoRe scores as SZL measurements.
Verify the dual-head output contract and measure the late-interaction compression claims (hierarchical token pooling plus asymmetric quantization) as storage-versus-quality deltas with receipts.
Keep training, model publication, provider routing and automatic promotion false until separate normal controls pass; no weight rehosting.

alignment.claimBoundary: The publication claims state-of-the-art retrieval at small scale for its class. Admission records the claims; it does not verify ViDoRe scores, qualify the encoders for governed retrieval or inference, or change any route.
